exec_summary: Site traffic (GA4, 2026-07-11 to 2026-07-17): growthbook.io had 14,761 sessions and 9,987 users (-9.6% week over week).

**Site performance**
- **Overall (GA4, all traffic):** 14,761 sessions (-9.6% WoW) | 9,987 users
- **Overall (GSC, organic search):** 3,381 clicks (+1.3% WoW) | 240,088 impressions (-37.1% WoW)
- **Homepage (/):** 8,570 GA4 sessions (-4.4% WoW) all-traffic | 1,805 GSC clicks (-0.3% WoW) organic | 12,877 GSC impressions (-24.6% WoW)
- **Pricing (/pricing):** 1,143 GA4 sessions (-5.5% WoW) all-traffic | 97 GSC clicks (+7.8% WoW) organic | 6,413 GSC impressions (-18.9% WoW)
- **Docs (docs.growthbook.io):** 4,512 GA4 sessions (+2.6% WoW) all-traffic | 948 GSC clicks (-9.0% WoW) organic | 112,310 GSC impressions (-35.1% WoW)
- **All other pages:** 7,688 GA4 sessions (-11.3% WoW) all-traffic | 527 GSC clicks (+36.5% WoW) organic | 202,164 GSC impressions (-39.7% WoW)
- The GSC impression drop is sitewide and steep (-37% overall). The all-other-pages GSC clicks are up +36.5% WoW despite the impression collapse — a disconnection worth watching. GA4 organic search sessions are 5,735, suggesting real traffic is partially holding even as Google impression counts fall. The impression drop may reflect GSC sampling/date-window shifts rather than a real visibility loss; verify in GSC directly before acting.

**New competitor activity**
- **Optimizely**'s /field-notes hub surfaced 145 pages in our tracking — a sitemap addition of mostly pre-existing content, not all net-new this week. The hub covers experimentation, A/B testing, AI-assisted marketing, and content optimization targeting digital marketers and growth teams. Three newly visible pieces are directly threat-level for GrowthBook: **"5 Myths Killing Your AB Testing And Experimentation Program"**, **"AI Experimentation"** (KD 52), and **"Agentic AI Experimentation Benchmark"** — all Tier 1, all intercepting evaluation-stage buyers. Two product-roadmap pieces are also newly visible: **"Remote MCP Server: Bring Experimentation Into AI Tools"** and **"Test Smarter and Faster With Agentic Experimentation"** — Optimizely is explicitly positioning against GrowthBook's MCP server angle.
- **PostHog**'s /blog surfaced 75 pages (sitemap addition across 3 categories, 16 tags) — technical content targeting engineers and PMs, the same audience as GrowthBook's docs.
- **Amplitude Exp**'s /docs surfaced 21 pages covering guides, surveys, heatmaps, and SDKs — targets developers evaluating experimentation tooling.
- ⚠️ No new pages detected from **Statsig**, **LaunchDarkly**, **Harness**, **Flagsmith**, or **Unleash** — consistent with a monitoring gap, not a content pause.

**New GrowthBook content**
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared** (published 2026-05-18): 189 clicks this week, up from 64 last week — new all-time high, position 8.9. Strongest organic mover on the site.
- **/blog/unleash-alternatives** (published 2026-06-19): 37 clicks, up from 11 last week — largest single-week jump for this post. Position 7.1. Momentum is real.
- **/blog/how-to-implement-feature-flags-at-scale** (published 2026-05-26): 23 clicks, 24,763 impressions, position 8.9 — high impression volume relative to clicks; answer-capsule treatment could convert impressions to clicks.
- **/blog/kpi-playbook-ab-testing-metrics** (published 2026-06-03): 25 clicks, position 6.9 — steady build continues.
- Three new pages detected via sitemap (publish dates unknown): **/blog/launchdarkly-alternatives**, **/insights/frequentist-vs-bayesian**, **/insights/optimizely-alternatives** — all at zero impressions. Internal links needed immediately.

**Strategic priorities (ACP)**
- **Top-10 footprint: 191 keywords (+102 over 3 months)** — strongest reading yet, up from +107 last week (trajectory confirmed).
- **BOFU comparison page fix is the highest-ROI unshipped work — now nine consecutive weeks.** Priority order by impression volume:
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-statsig** (ACP 82, pos 6.9, 15,025 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited)
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-posthog** (ACP 80, pos 6.4, 6,191 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited)
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly** (ACP 82, pos 8.9, 4,074 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook cited)
  - **/compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely** (ACP 80, pos 7.9, 3,643 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited) — Optimizely's MCP content makes this more urgent
- **"what is a/b testing"** (pos 9.73, 1,937 impressions, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited) — moved closer to top 10 this week. Same page as **"a/b testing"** (pos 11.33, 4,240 impressions). Both capturable with one answer-capsule H2 on **/blog/what-is-a-b-testing**.
- **/blog/launchdarkly-alternatives** and **/insights/optimizely-alternatives** detected this week — zero impressions. These directly map to GrowthBook's highest-value comparison queries; internal links are the immediate unlock.

**Organic movers worth watching**
- **/blog/best-open-source-feature-flagging-tools-compared**: 189 clicks (up from 64 last week, +195%) — new high. Confirm current position in DataForSEO.
- **/blog/unleash-alternatives**: 37 clicks (up from 11 last week, +236%) — strongest week yet; internal links still the lever.
- **/insights/best-ab-testing-tools-product-analytics**: 18 clicks (up from 1 last week) — new entrant; watch one more week to confirm.
- **/insights/launchdarkly-pricing**: 9 clicks (up from 1 last week) — early traction on a BOFU query; worth one internal link push.
- **/blog/unleash-alternatives** decline noted last week has fully reversed.

**Recommended actions**
- **Ship the answer-capsule + comparison table + schema fix to /compare/growthbook-vs-statsig and /compare/growthbook-vs-launchdarkly this week** (ACP 82 each). Statsig page sits at 15,025 impressions/28d — highest in the comparison set. Nine consecutive weeks without shipping.
- **Apply the same fix to /compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely** (ACP 80, 3,643 impressions/28d, AI Overview present, GrowthBook NOT cited). Optimizely's new MCP-server and agentic-experimentation content is actively competing for the same evaluation-stage buyer.
- **Add internal links to /blog/launchdarkly-alternatives, /insights/optimizely-alternatives, and /insights/frequentist-vs-bayesian** — all detected this week at zero impressions. These map to high-value queries and will not rank without link equity.
- **Add answer-capsule H2 to /blog/what-is-a-b-testing** — captures both "what is a/b testing" (pos 9.73, 1,937 impressions) and "a/b testing" (pos 11.33, 4,240 impressions) in one edit; AI Overview present for both, GrowthBook not cited in either.

**Data quality flags**
- GSC impressions dropped -37% sitewide WoW while clicks held roughly flat — verify in GSC Search Console UI before treating as a real visibility signal; this pattern is consistent with a GSC data window or sampling artifact.

2. Optimize /compare/growthbook-vs-optimizely (ACP 80, pos 7.9, 3,643 impressions/28d, GrowthBook NOT cited in AI Overview): Same capsule + table + schema treatment. Check the top queries driving impressions in GSC and align the H1 and meta description to the dominant query. This page has significant latent demand.
